limitations: Spatial error correlation is not empirically calibrated

Thermal inertia is not a temperature map

Uncertainty penalty is an edge-level heuristic
Monte Carlo tests keep selected routes fixed
Route feasibility is not a guarantee of astronaut safety
Endpoints are illustrative, not mission waypoints
